verify_points.desc: A v3 composition exposes multiple clips as the primary authoring units.
Selecting one clip shows that clip's local component/tts/subtitle_timeline/subtitle tracks.
TTS produces audio and a timeline; subtitle_timeline reads that timeline; subtitle renders from subtitle_timeline without inline words in the authoring JSON.
The v3 composition compiles to the existing runtime source and exports to MP4 with audio and burned-in subtitles.

items.title: Compile v3 clips and local tracks to runtime source
